description:
The CLI interactive mode (5-step wizard) currently does not offer users the option to
select open table formats (Parquet, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) for data generation.

While the `--convert-format` flag exists for non-interactive CLI usage, interactive
mode users must either know about this flag or manually add it after completing the
wizard. This creates a gap in the interactive experience.

Add a new step or extend an existing step in the interactive wizard to allow users
to select their preferred data format, with intelligent defaults based on the selected
platform (e.g., Delta for Databricks, Iceberg for Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery).
